text:
Maya Chen: Quick sync — we need to lock down scope for the upcoming internal privacy/audit review. Can folks share availability? Proposed slots: Tue 10:00-10:30 or Thu 15:00-15:30. React with ✅ for preferred slot.

Priya Singh: ✅ Tue works for me (morning preferred).

Sam Ortiz: I'm out Tue AM, Thu is better for me.

Alex Park: Either is ok from infra side, Thu might let me finish a PR.

DevSecBot: Reminder: please attach latest data inventory and system diagram before the meeting (see playbook).

Maya Chen: Draft agenda pasted below — please flag anything missing.
```
1) Goal: finalize audit scope (PII, logs, backups)
2) Threat-model review: high-risk flows and outstanding mitigations (PR #428)
3) Access & RBAC: owners, evidence checklist, re-cert window
4) Crypto & key management sanity checks
5) Action items + owners + due dates
```

Priya Singh: Can someone drop link to PR and the data map?

Alex Park: PR link: https://git.internal/redwood/platform/pulls/428

Maya Chen: Data map: https://confluence.redwood/privsec/data-map (updated yesterday)

Riley Gomez: Quick ask — can we add a 5m file-access matrix review (who can read backup snapshots)?

Maya Chen: Good call, adding as agenda item 2.5.

Sam Ortiz: I'll own auth logs evidence collection.

Priya Singh: I'll cover encryption at rest and key rotation notes.

Maya Chen: Looks like consensus for Thu 15:00. @eng-privsec please ping any stakeholders not in thread. :thumbsup:

DevSecBot: Calendar invite created for Thu 15:00. Conference code: RDW-SEC-57.

Priya Singh: Ack.

Sam Ortiz: Ack.

Maya Chen: If you have blockers, post them here by EOD Wed so we can adjust the agenda. Thanks!
